info.title: Argos connected space — Clarté
info.description: Target contract. Only operations marked available are implemented by F01/F03/F05/F06. Existing auth/sites/usage routes keep their current contracts until their own implementation lots. The BFF uses HttpOnly cookies and forwards a server-side Bearer session to Java; no public API keys.

post.description: F03: verified account, Origin and CSRF required. One credit reserved atomically with queue admission and personal URL. Same owner/key/payload replays the exact run even at zero remaining quota; a different payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict. No public report token. Requested profile snapshot is not an assertion about collector versions. Errors use the existing lowercase legacy envelope.

CreateDiscovery.description: Shape validation only. DNS/SSRF, exact host, robots and configured resource limits remain server/transport checks.
